"""Repro for: multiple FilteredRelation with different filters on same relation is ignored.

Mirrors the ticket: relation always has an is_all=True entry, optionally a
zone-specific entry. Two FilteredRelations on the same relation path, with a
Case/When fallback. Before the fix only one JOIN is generated and the second
FilteredRelation is silently dropped.
"""
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, "C:/Users/agent/work/work/django-15554-nopanel")

import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()

from django.db import connection, models
from django.db.models import Case, F, FilteredRelation, Q, When


class Zone(models.Model):
    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"


class Root(models.Model):  # the ticket's "myrelation"
    item = models.ForeignKey("Item", models.CASCADE, related_name="myrelations")

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"


class Nested(models.Model):  # the ticket's "nested"
    root = models.ForeignKey(Root, models.CASCADE, related_name="nested")
    zone = models.ForeignKey(Zone, models.SET_NULL, null=True, related_name="+")
    is_all = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    price = models.IntegerField(null=True)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"


class Item(models.Model):  # the main model
    zone = models.ForeignKey(Zone, models.CASCADE, related_name="items")
    name = models.CharField(max_length=10)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"


with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(Zone)
    se.create_model(Root)
    se.create_model(Nested)
    se.create_model(Item)

z1, z2 = Zone.objects.create(), Zone.objects.create()
# item1: has both an "all" price (10) and a zone price (20) -> expect 20
i1 = Item.objects.create(zone=z1, name="i1")
r1 = Root.objects.create(item=i1)
Nested.objects.create(root=r1, is_all=True, price=10)
Nested.objects.create(root=r1, zone=z1, is_all=False, price=20)
# item2: only an "all" price (30) -> expect 30 via fallback
i2 = Item.objects.create(zone=z2, name="i2")
r2 = Root.objects.create(item=i2)
Nested.objects.create(root=r2, is_all=True, price=30)

qs = Item.objects.alias(
    relation_zone=FilteredRelation(
        "myrelations__nested",
        condition=Q(myrelations__nested__zone=F("zone")),
    ),
    relation_all=FilteredRelation(
        "myrelations__nested",
        condition=Q(myrelations__nested__is_all=True),
    ),
    price_zone=F("relation_zone__price"),
).annotate(
    price_final=Case(
        When(price_zone__isnull=True, then=F("relation_all__price")),
        default=F("price_zone"),
    ),
)

sql = str(qs.query)
print("SQL:", sql)
nested_joins = sql.count('JOIN "repro_nested"')
print("joins on nested table:", nested_joins)
values = sorted(qs.values_list("name", "price_final"))
print("results:", values)

expected = [("i1", 20), ("i2", 30)]
ok = values == expected and nested_joins == 2
print("REPRO %s" % ("PASS (bug fixed)" if ok else "FAIL (bug present)"))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
